headline: Univastu wins Rs 24.36 lakh order from L&T for MMRDA Line 4
summary: Univastu secured a confirmed work order worth Rs 24.36 lakh from Larsen & Toubro for E&M works at Gaimukh Inspection Pit. The firm maintains a robust order book of Rs 601.46 crore, representing 7.53 quarters of average revenue.

headline: Apsis Aerocom wins Rs 4.30 crore order from Healthcare client
summary: Company secures confirmed work order worth Rs 4.296867 crore from a local Healthcare customer. Execution within 7 months. TTM revenue is zero, making book-to-bill metrics unavailable.

headline: Mason Infratech secures Rs 12.9 crore order from Cowtown Infotech
summary: Mason Infratech wins a significant Rs 12.9 crore order for core and shell civil work at Palava Waterfront T2. The 18-month contract adds to its Q2FY27 inflow, bringing total disclosed orders to Rs 23.51 crore.

headline: Bikewo Green Tech wins Rs 66.46 crore order from Reliance
summary: Company secures confirmed work order for EV tractor hiring and operation services. Contract runs till July 2033 with pro-rata payments. Filing notes values are indicative estimates.

headline: Eicher Motors launches Flying Flea C6 in Europe
summary: Eicher Motors expands its electric mobility brand Flying Flea to five European cities with the C6 launch. Priced at €5,990, the bike features 104 km range and advanced tech.

headline: Vedant Fashions pays ₹50,000 fine for label violation
summary: Vedant Fashions Limited settled a Legal Metrology violation regarding missing size labels on a Sherwani by paying a ₹50,000 compounding fee to the Delhi authorities in September 2026.

headline: Quint Digital CCPS and Warrants to List on BSE
summary: Quint Digital Ltd has received listing approval for its partly paid-up CCPS and warrants on BSE. Trading commences September 18, 2026. The rights issue includes 82.6 lakh units of each security.

headline: Tahmar Enterprises gets Maharashtra excise IMFL permit
summary: Tahmar Enterprises has received permission from Maharashtra Excise to manufacture IMFL from grain-based spirit, marking a key regulatory milestone for the company.

headline: Railtel Wins Rs 63.15 Cr Order from Prasar Bharti for WAVES OTT
summary: Railtel secured a Rs 63.15 crore Letter of Intent from Prasar Bharti for additional features on the WAVES OTT Platform. This adds to the company's growing order book, bringing total disclosed orders to Rs 2961.22 crore across 46 deals.

headline: Stocks in Focus: Tahmar, Infosys, Mazagon Dock
summary: Tahmar Enterprises surges 20% on IMFL nod. Infosys expands AI hub. Mazagon Dock signs greenfield shipyard MoU. Fortis wins Delhi hospital deal. Tempsens posts profit growth.

headline: Onmobile Global audit panel probes operational concerns
summary: A consultant has raised concerns about possible operational issues at Onmobile Global. The audit committee has engaged an independent law firm to investigate the matter.

headline: Goodricke Group sells art assets for ₹27.75 crore
summary: Goodricke Group Limited sold non-core art assets via auction for ₹27.75 crore, crossing materiality thresholds. The transaction aims to unlock value and focus on core business operations.

headline: HGM acquires 1.45% stake in XBP Global for $579,997
summary: HandsOn Global Management (HGM) Ltd acquired a 1.45% stake in XBP Global Holdings Inc for US$579,997 via private placement. The investment aligns with HGM's strategy to integrate AI-led automation into critical workflows.

headline: Bhangdiya family triggers open offer for 26% stake in GSL Securities
summary: The Bhangdiya family has triggered an open offer to acquire a 26% stake in GSL Securities at ₹42 per share. The move follows a share purchase agreement for a 44.62% block from the promoter group, marking a change in control.

headline: Borosil Renewables targets ₹100 crore rooftop solar revenue
summary: Borosil Renewables is entering the rooftop solar segment, targeting ₹100 crore revenue in the first year, while expanding solar glass capacity from 1,000 TPD to 1,600 TPD, with full benefits expected by FY28.

headline: Govt may cut vegetable oil import taxes amid rising prices
summary: The Indian government is considering reducing import duties on vegetable oils as domestic prices climb, a move that could ease inflationary pressure on edible oil consumers.

headline: India can import only 642 UK cars in 2026 under FTA
summary: Under the India-UK FTA, only 642 cars can be imported from the UK in 2026, far below the 10,000-unit quota, due to how the quota allocation works.

headline: BARC in talks with RIL, Adani for ₹9,000-cr SMR project
summary: BARC is negotiating with Reliance Industries and Adani Group for a ₹9,000 crore small modular reactor project in India, as reported by Financial Express.

headline: IEEFA: ₹2,000cr EV charging scheme covers under 2% of need
summary: IEEFA says India's ₹2,000 crore EV charging scheme may cover under 2% of the 1.32 mn chargers needed by 2030, highlighting a significant infrastructure gap.

headline: PNGRB approves transfer of 6 CGD areas to Gail Gas
summary: PNGRB has approved the transfer of 6 city gas distribution areas to Gail Gas, paving the way for a proposed ₹3,000 crore IPO and minority stake dilution.

headline: Rupee opens weaker at 95.9850 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.9850 against the US dollar, weaker than the previous close of 95.9550, reflecting a marginal depreciation in early trade.

headline: India 10-year bond yield rises to 7.07%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield rose to 7.0714% from the previous close of 7.0524%, reflecting an uptick in yield levels.

headline: PB Fintech co-CEO denies resignation rumours
summary: PB Fintech's co-CEO has categorically denied rumours of his departure from the role, addressing the speculation directly in an interview.

headline: BEML's international order book hits all-time high
summary: BEML reports its international business order book has reached an all-time high, with the overall order book shaping up well, led by the rail and metro segments.

headline: Rentomojo lists at ₹482.45, above issue price of ₹404
summary: Rentomojo shares listed at ₹482.45 on NSE, surpassing the issue price of ₹404, marking a strong debut on the exchange.

headline: Steamhouse India debuts above issue price on NSE
summary: Steamhouse India made its stock market debut at ₹94.5 per share on NSE, a premium over its issue price of ₹81 per share.

headline: Manipal Payment Solutions lists below issue price
summary: Manipal Payment And Identity Solutions listed its shares at ₹330 on NSE, below the issue price of ₹339, marking a subdued market debut for the company.

headline: LCC Projects lists at ₹189, a premium over ₹146 issue price
summary: LCC Projects shares listed on NSE at ₹189 per share, a premium over the issue price of ₹146 per share, marking a strong market debut for the company.

headline: Karamtara Engineering lists at ₹320, above IPO price
summary: Karamtara Engineering shares listed at ₹320 on NSE, a premium over the IPO price of ₹254 per share, marking a strong market debut for the company.

headline: Asset reconstruction company lists shares at ₹139
summary: An asset reconstruction company listed its shares at ₹139, matching the issue price, reflecting a flat debut on the exchange.

headline: Nitin Spinners Gets 'Adequate' ESG Rating
summary: Nitin Spinners Ltd received an 'Adequate' ESG rating with a score of 50 from ESG Risk Assessments and Insights Limited on September 16, 2026, under SEBI regulations.

headline: Excel Industries earns EcoVadis Silver rating
summary: Excel Industries Limited has been awarded a Silver Rating in the EcoVadis Sustainability Assessment. The recognition places the company among the top 15% of businesses assessed globally, validating its sustainability management framework across environment, ethics, and procurement pillars.

headline: Steamhouse India targets 23% margin
summary: Steamhouse India anticipates maintaining a profit margin of around 23% in its steam business segment, signaling confidence in future margin enhancement despite limited disclosed data.

headline: SEBI reviews broker concerns on UPI transaction fees
summary: SEBI is looking into concerns raised by brokers regarding fees charged on UPI transactions, signalling regulatory attention to cost structures in digital payment processing for securities trading.

headline: Petronet LNG to host analyst meet on Sep 22
summary: Petronet LNG Limited will participate in the Anand Rathi Flagship Bharat conference in Mumbai on September 22, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Cummins India withholds FY26 dividend for KYC non-compliant folios
summary: Cummins India Limited has withheld the final dividend of ₹46 per share for FY26 for shareholders with non-compliant KYC details. The company urges investors to update bank and KYC information via their RTA or DPs to claim the payout electronically as per SEBI regulations.

headline: LTM wins Avasant Digital Masters Award 2026
summary: LTM Limited has been recognized with the Digital Masters Award 2026 in the Innovator category by Avasant. The firm was shortlisted among 18 providers from a pool of over 76 global technology service companies.

headline: Finkurve Financial Services to host analyst meet on Sep 30
summary: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd will participate in Arihant Capital's Bharat Connect Conference on September 30, 2026. Management will discuss past financial results and publicly available information.

headline: NSE listing on BSE requires NSE no-objection: SEBI
summary: SEBI Chairman stated that NSE can list and trade on BSE only if NSE provides a no-objection. The condition places the decision with NSE before any cross-exchange listing proceeds.
